name: app-icon-set-on-dark-phone-home-screen-thumbnail
title: Home-screen icon set, small thumbnail crop
whatItIs: A smaller-format crop of the same angled dark phone displaying a grid of colourful gradient icons, used as a project thumbnail.
whatItMeans: Still legible at small size; bright icons on black keep instant appeal.
techniques: Recrop tightly so icons fill the frame.
Keep the top-left icon bright as the entry point.
Preserve the dark background for contrast.
Use the phone edge as a diagonal leading line.

vocabulary.definition: A version cropped for small display.
A device edge used as a leading line.
The brightest element where the eye starts.
A black background for colourful items.
